title: Remarks on the Boston Unramified Fontaine-Mazur Conjecture, II
summary: In this paper, we investigate Boston's generalization of the unramified Fontaine-Mazur conjecture for Galois representations. From a group-theoretic perspective, we first show that the conjecture can be reduced to the case of certain distinguished classes of $p$-adic analytic groups and $\mathbb{F}_{p}[[T]]$-adic analytic groups. Specifically, these are open subgroups of the groups of integral points of absolutely simple algebraic groups defined over non-Archimedean local fields.
